wiki.title: Pumpkin Prince
wiki.text:
The Pumpkin Prince is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Super Spooktacular. He is the pumpkin monster, his main goal while arrived is to terrorizing the four locations, though his goal was said to rule all of Sacred Grove.

Battle
Open World
During the Super Spooktacular, a message will pop up saying "The Pumpkin Prince is terrorizing in <Warpstone>". While the Pumpkin Prince is arrived, ectoplasmic destabilizer dispseners appear on the pathways of four locations which you will find somewhere near where the Pumpkin Prince is (he is walking around somewhere in that area and anyone can attack him). All you must do is keep firing at him with your ectoplasmic shooter which will be at the bottom of your screen where your combat moves are.

The Pumpkin Prince can spawn undead enemies such as grave elementals or necrowart zombies that will attack you with effects that slow you down. The Pumpkin Prince can also attack you with himself and if he strikes you will be turned into a necrowart zombie and lose your ectoplasmic shooter ability. You will have to pick up another one when the effect wears off.

Once defeated, he will cry a call in defeat and drop a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Super Spooktacular reward. If he wins he will cry a call of victory and will not drop anything.

Bone Bog Cemetery
The Pumpkin Prince appears in the Bone Bog Cemetery, located in Blackspore Swamp during the Super Spooktacular, which at one point will require you to encounter him in a battle which requires you to be level 13 combat job or above to enter. You going to the dungeon with Lucinda. You will go to fight against the Pumpkin Prince, and send his undead army back to the ghost world. The Pumpkin Prince also spawn the ghosts which will heal him in a battle
